annotations.title: Open a film in the editor

description: Where the user opens a film in the Cutscene editor, to do by hand what is done there: put in their pictures (screenshots, logo), look at it playing, export it. Online it is the film's address on their account; with the connector on their machine, the film's file, which the editor opens. Without a name, the editor's « Mes films », which lists the films kept in the browser it opens in as well as those on the account: where the user finds a film list_films does not give. Give it to the user with what is left for them to do.

name.description: The film's name in the working folder (see list_films)
